answer: Copying the same citations across 63 aliases thus pays the reading cost 63 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the nadir check immediately, the jetty audit keeps the resolved set and the shale replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
